code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    # Extend each occupied row and column outward; marker cells stop the ray.
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0-1,-1,-1):
            if grid[r][c]==1: break
            out[r][c]=2
        for c in range(c1+1,w):
            if grid[r][c]==1: break
            out[r][c]=2
    for c in range(c0,c1+1):
        for r in range(r0-1,-1,-1):
            if grid[r][c]==1: break
            out[r][c]=2
        for r in range(r1+1,h):
            if grid[r][c]==1: break
            out[r][c]=2
    return out
'''
